POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.

2. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.

5. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

6. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.

7. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

8. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Special engines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Careers in Power Mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle batteries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
